questions.q: Two figures with exactly the same shape and size are ____.
Which rule says two triangles are congruent if three sides of one equal three sides of the other?
In the SAS rule, the angle must be ____.
questions.explanation: It must be the included angle.

questions.q: Which is NOT a rule for congruence of triangles?
questions.explanation: Equal angles alone give a similar triangle, not necessarily a congruent one.

questions.q: Two squares with side 5 cm each are ____.
questions.explanation: Same shape and same size means congruent.

questions.q: In congruent triangles, corresponding parts are ____.
questions.explanation: Corresponding sides and angles are equal.
